market_name: Will no Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the market probability move is sustained or noise; cross-check 2y/10y yields and Fed funds futures for confirmation.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT tick move vs implied rate path; look for any Fed speaker headlines or data (CPI/jobs) explaining the repricing.
time_plan.2h: Assess whether move is idiosyncratic to this contract or broad across rate markets (SOFR futures).
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate against any macro release; check if TLT move faded or extended.
time_plan.12h: Final read: did TLT close lower with higher yields consistent with hawkish repricing, or did it revert?

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 'no Fed rate cuts in 2026' is a hawkish repricing of the policy path. Fewer expected cuts lifts the front-end and pulls up the whole curve, pushing long-duration Treasury prices down. TLT is a clean, liquid proxy for duration. Direction is conditional on the anomaly being a move UP in the 'No' probability (hawkish); a fall in that probability would flip the sign.

predictions.reasoning: Fewer expected Fed cuts (rising 'No cuts' probability) implies a higher-for-longer policy rate, which is typically dollar-supportive via rate differentials. UUP is a liquid DXY proxy. Effect is small over 12h and highly conditional on the direction of the probability move.

evidence_used: Market question tracks number of 25bp Fed cuts in 2026, a direct proxy for the expected policy path
Rate-cut expectations map mechanically to Treasury yields and the dollar via well-established transmission
The market resolves to 'No' if cuts become impossible, so probability shifts reflect changing easing odds
uncertainty_notes: Direction is fully conditional on which way the implied probability moved; the question framing is symmetric
A 12h window rarely produces 700bps+ moves in liquid rate/FX ETFs, so this is almost certainly NOT tradable under the threshold
Prediction-market probability moves on this contract may lag or merely track already-public Fed communications and data

llm_justification.summary: This market is a direct gauge of the 2026 Fed easing path. A sharp increase in the 'no cuts' probability is a hawkish repricing that should push long-duration Treasuries (TLT) down and the dollar (UUP) up; a decrease flips both. Both mappings are mechanically sound but the 12h magnitudes are small (tens of bps), far below the 700bps tradable threshold, so this is a low-confidence, non-tradable research signal.
key_assumptions: The anomaly is a move UP in the 'No cuts' probability (hawkish); otherwise signs invert
No competing macro release or central-bank event dominates the window
Standard rate-transmission relationships hold over the 12h horizon
failure_modes: The probability move reflects information already public (Fed minutes, speeches, CPI) and is already priced into TLT/UUP
The direction of the anomaly is dovish rather than hawkish, inverting the thesis
Rate/FX ETFs move far less than 700bps in 12h, so no tradable signal exists
The prediction market is thin/noisy and the probability move is not information-bearing
Idiosyncratic flows (equity risk sentiment, geopolitics) drive TLT/UUP more than rate-path repricing
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
